# Python Explorer

> A searchable database of Python libraries and their uses.

URL: https://jamditis.github.io/python-explorer/
Author: Joe Amditis
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/jamditis/python-explorer

Python Explorer is an interactive directory of 345+ Python libraries across
nine domains: Web, Data Science, Machine Learning, DevOps, Automation, Design,
Media, Visualization, and more. It includes fuzzy search, natural language
filtering, and curated collections.

Key features:
- Fuzzy search powered by Fuse.js across library names and descriptions
- Natural language search with "I have" and "I want to" guided dropdowns
- Live analytics with domain distribution and category breakdown charts
- Side-by-side library comparison tool
- Curated journalism and media toolkit with 39 tagged libraries
- 10 featured collections including Data Journalism Toolkit
- Export filtered results as requirements.txt
- Zero build process, pure static site served from CDN
